title: Calligraph
description: Fluid text and number transitions on Motion: shared letters stay while the rest blur in and out, digits roll by place, or spin like a slot machine. The wrapper animates its width to fit.

props.name: children
props.description: The text or number to show. Change it to animate.

props.name: variant
props.description: `text` keeps the letters two strings share (longest common subsequence) and blurs the rest in and out; `number` rolls each digit column up or down by the change's sign; `slots` spins each digit through 0 to 9.

props.name: animation
props.description: The transition preset: `default` is a 380 ms ease-out curve; the others are springs.

props.name: drift
props.description: Text only: the most, in pixels, that entering and leaving letters spread, scaled by how much of the text changed.

props.name: trend
props.description: Text only: 1 enters from below, -1 from above, 0 has no vertical trend.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds of delay between digits (number and slots).

props.name: initial
props.description: Animate the first value in on mount.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the last glyph finishes animating (text and number).

props.name: autoSize
props.description: Animate the wrapper's width to fit the new content.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Show each change at once when the user prefers reduced motion.

a11y: The value is kept once as visually hidden text for screen readers; every animated glyph is aria-hidden, so a change is read as one value, not letter by letter.
It renders inline text with no role of its own; to announce changes, wrap it in a live region (for example aria-live="polite").
With the default respectReducedMotion, every change is instant when the user prefers reduced motion.
The text variant sets dir="auto" so Latin letters stay in order inside a right-to-left page; the number and slots variants are always left to right, as digits are.
docs:
Installed `Calligraph` (`@/components/ui/calligraph`, with its renderers in `@/components/ui/calligraph-renderers`) and its diffing helpers (`@/lib/calligraph-core`). It needs `motion`.

```tsx
import { Calligraph } from "@/components/ui/calligraph";

<Calligraph>{word}</Calligraph>
<Calligraph variant="number">{price}</Calligraph>
<Calligraph variant="slots">{count}</Calligraph>
```

Change the children to animate. Pass the formatted string (for example from `Intl.NumberFormat`) for prices and counts. The motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion` by default.
